item.title: Wigan rejects Bellway’s 83-home pitch
item.description: Close proximity to Chanters Industrial Estate was the root of the council’s decision to refuse the housebuilder’s plans for a mix of two-bed, three-bed, and four-bed houses on a five-acre greenfield site off Douglas Road in Atherton. The post Wigan rejects Bellway’s 83-home pitch appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Lancashire Development Update 2026 | Summary + gallery
item.description: Attendees at Place North West’s Lancashire Development Update in Blackpool last week were told the county stands on the cusp on a new era and were urged to get behind its ambitious £20bn growth vision. The post Lancashire Development Update 2026 | Summary + gallery appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Trafford greenlights 3,000-capacity ice arena
item.description: ICITIES has secured consent for the project, which will be constructed on the site of the former Soccer Dome at Peel Waters’ TraffordCity. The post Trafford greenlights 3,000-capacity ice arena appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: New primary school detailed for Ellesmere Port
item.description: Situated on a three-acre plot at the heart of the future Ledsham Garden Village, the 315-place educational facility has a target opening date of September 2028. The post New primary school detailed for Ellesmere Port appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Shop move to trigger North Manchester regen
item.description: Plans have been lodged to relocate Moston Superstore, helping to unlock a proposed public square as part of a £25m vision. The post Shop move to trigger North Manchester regen appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: St Helens waves through 1.6m sq ft industrial
item.description: Alongside joint venture partner Langtree, the council can now push ahead with phase two of the redevelopment of Parkside Colliery in Newton-le-Willows, which includes manufacturing space as well as general industrial accommodation. The post St Helens waves through 1.6m sq ft industrial appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Manchester shuffles funding deck for new regen team
item.description: Targeted regeneration programmes in Longsight, Levenshulme, Northenden and Cheetham Hill are on the cards following sign-off for dedicated officers overseeing delivery. The post Manchester shuffles funding deck for new regen team appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Taylor Wimpey lines up Helsby housing
item.description: Plans have been lodged for 112 homes, including 50 affordable residences, off Robin Hood Lane. The post Taylor Wimpey lines up Helsby housing appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Blackpool lets 22,000 sq ft to NHS as public sector crowds in
item.description: Some 300 staff will move to an office on the first floor of No1 Bickerstaffe Square, adding to the growing throng of public sector workers now based in the town centre. The post Blackpool lets 22,000 sq ft to NHS as public sector crowds in appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: MPs cast doubt on £45bn Northern Powerhouse Rail
item.description: During a hearing in the House of Commons, transport secretary Heidi Alexander revealed plans for NPR are to be designed in full before any contracts are tendered and declared 'railways are not built overnight', as opposition ministers questioned the scheme's funding and timelines. The post MPs cast doubt on £45bn Northern Powerhouse Rail appeared first on Place North West.
